ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Secondary Level. This course is for students in the English and/or classics certification programs. NOTE: You are required to take SPED 205, Section A, CRN 30811, which meets during the first 5 weeks of the term (August 24 to October 3). SPED 405, Section S1, CRN 35774, will meet during the final 10 weeks of the semester (October 4 to December 9).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Secondary & Continuing Educ or Classics or English major(s).
